 tadanucchede ca sādhikāratvam eva cittasyeti mokṣānupapattiḥ / Kiṃ ca pralīnānām
api saṃskārāṇāṃ kadācid yogīśvarasaṃkalpādinā dagdhabījasyeva punarudbodho'pi saṃbhāvyetety
āśaṅkām apākaroti-- vyutthānanirodheti / Asaṃprajñātāpekṣayā samādhiprajñāpi vyutthānaṃ / Ato
vyutthānaṃ jñānasāmānyaṃ nirodhasamādhiś cāsaṃprajñātas tadubhayaprabhavaiḥ saha sahitaiḥ
kaivalyabhāgīyaiḥ kaivalyahetukarmasaṃskārair viśiṣṭaṃ cittaṃ svakīyaprakṛtau nityāyāṃ svayam
